name: Registered Contract 20
definition: Document that a user must file with an authorised servicer for each contract that involves foreign currency transactions with non residents.

OriginalContractRegistrationRequest.name: Original Contract Registration Request
OriginalContractRegistrationRequest.definition: Unique identification of the contract registration creation, amendment or closure request.

ReportingParty.name: Reporting Party
ReportingParty.definition: Party registering the currency control contract.

RegistrationAgent.name: Registration Agent
RegistrationAgent.definition: Agent which registers the currency control contract.

IssuerFinancialInstitution.name: Issuer Financial Institution
IssuerFinancialInstitution.definition: Financial institution of the issuer of the contract.

Contract.name: Contract
Contract.definition: Details of the contract being registered.

ContractBalance.name: Contract Balance
ContractBalance.definition: Contract balance on date of contract registration.

PaymentScheduleType.name: Payment Schedule Type
PaymentScheduleType.definition: Type of the payment schedule provided in the contract.

RegisteredContractIdentification.name: Registered Contract Identification
RegisteredContractIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of the registered contract as assigned by the registration agent.

PreviousRegisteredContractIdentification.name: Previous Registered Contract Identification
PreviousRegisteredContractIdentification.definition: Identification of a previously defined registered contract linked to the same underlying contract.||Usage:|This is the identification of a previous contract registration for the same underlying contract, which was closed. In most cases, this is used when a reporting party moves from one registration agent to another.

RegisteredContractJournal.name: Registered Contract Journal
RegisteredContractJournal.definition: Journal of previously closed registered contracts for the same underlying contract, which were requested at the same registration agent.

Amendment.name: Amendment
Amendment.definition: Details on amendments to the registered contract.

Submission.name: Submission
Submission.definition: Provides the communication method for the submission of the registered contract.

Delivery.name: Delivery
Delivery.definition: Provides the communication method for the delivery of the registered contract.

LoanPrincipalAmount.name: Loan Principal Amount
LoanPrincipalAmount.definition: Amount of money the borrower pays back to the lender outside of interests and charges.||Usage:|Only applicable for loan contracts.

EstimatedDateIndicator.name: Estimated Date Indicator
EstimatedDateIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the dates provided are estimates or not.

InterCompanyLoan.name: Inter Company Loan
InterCompanyLoan.definition: Indicates whether loan in which both the lender and the borrower are divisions of the same corporation or not.||Usage:|Only applicable for loan contracts.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Further information on the registered contract.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
